Defeated by Nishino Flower, Sakura 
Bakushin O was unable to go out on a high 
note. Yet the result is substantial 
enough. She wishes to advance to the next 
stage.

However, she wondered why her Trainer kept 
trying to steer her away from the Bakushin 
Road. In order to persuade her, the 
Trainer—

She comes up with a plan to run a total of 
3,600 meters, straddling across three 
races: the Hakodate Sprint Stakes, the CBC 
Sho, and the Centaur Stakes!

...Fascinated by the distance of 3,600 
meters, Sakura Bakushin O gained momentum, 
determined to run all three races to the 
very end.
